card.name: Degree sign after storage temperatures
card.fires_on: The degree sign º right after a temperature number such as 25, 2 or 104, before C or F, mostly in storage and temperature text. It also fires, more weakly, on the apostrophe in contractions like don’t.

modes.label: Degree sign in temperatures
modes.description: The º symbol after a number in storage or fever temperature ranges.
modes.example: at room temperature up to 25<<º>>C (77ºF), protected

modes.label: Curly apostrophe in contraction
modes.description: The ’ in a contraction such as don’t in general web prose.

card.writes: It likely promotes line-ending or word-completing pieces, with no clear link to the degree sign.
card.plain: It marks the degree symbol written right after a temperature number in storage instructions.
